$Comment: The capstone of the Howling Sands campaign: the Scarak Brood Queen, a boss fight run by the
game's own encounter scripts at a site the server owner places once (see
Server/EncounterManager/Sands_Brood_Queen_Encounter.json for the fight and the install).
The step counts a defeat of that fight. Target is the encounter SCRIPT id, never the queen's
creature id: the fight changes her role between phases, so a step naming the script holds
through every phase where a creature id would not. There is no Qualifier, because nothing hands
an open-world fight a difficulty label. Every participant the fight credited gets the step at
once, however many shared the kill, and the fight pays its own loot on top of what this quest
Requires keeps it behind the campaign finale, so it is offered only once the apex hunts are
done; Hidden with RequirePrerequisites keeps it out of the log until then. The reward is the
arc's own, on hand-in at the dunewalker; the queen's spoils are the encounter's and land as she
Enabled is false, matching every other quest of the desert campaign, so the whole arc opens
with one sweep of these leaves. A player who already holds it (none can, pre-release) could
still finish it. Flip it to true, or drop the line, together with the rest once the desert
